source.selection_policy: Entries are admitted only when the dictionary explicitly labels the lemma v2a. The original pre-v11 B/C cohort remains intact; Stage 1N adds a separate early-alphabet class-only batch. No inflected paradigm surface is taken from this source.
source.benchmark_independence_note: This is a distinct 2019 dictionary source, not the Zorc & Issa 1990 v7 textbook. It shares an author with v7, so it is not claimed author-independent. No frozen benchmark answer row is used as class evidence.

bushi.gloss: cause someone to become sick; make someone sad / throw doubt on something

butaaci.gloss: cause to emit; cause to gush out

buubi.gloss: chase away; speed; make run or fly; spray water on

buuxi.gloss: fill up or out; wind a watch; charge a battery

notes: This file records reviewed lemma-to-class knowledge only.
